git_diff: No tracked production files modified during investigation
reproduction_condition: Conversation must have active_order_id from a prior turn. Then query explicit product, then implicit follow-up (e.g. 'What is its price?').

root_cause.description: AIOrchestrator.process_message() passes route_decision.intent.entities (MERGED: explicit + context-inherited) as _explicit_entities to update_slots_domain_aware(). When the merged dict contains both product_id (explicit) and order_id (context-inherited), the if new_product_id: block sets active_product_id then clears order. But the subsequent if new_order_id: block (independent, not elif) then re-sets active_order_id = ORD-025 and clears active_product_id = None. The product slot is lost. The subsequent implicit follow-up finds only order_id in context, triggering ORDER_INQUIRY.
root_cause.contributing_gap: IntentResult.entities stores merged (context + explicit) entities. IntentResult has no separate explicit_entities field. Orchestrator cannot distinguish explicit from context-merged without re-computing.

security_impact.notes: SC10 confirmed: unauthorized ORD-003 does not persist via revert_slots(). Subsequent implicit reference returns no-data, not foreign customer data.

scenario_results.SC1_known_failure: FAIL — Order ORD-025 returned instead of Product PROD-002
scenario_results.SC6_explicit_entity_in_t3: PASS — Explicit product_id in query overrides context
scenario_results.SC8_what_is_the_price: FAIL — Same root cause (no explicit product_id in query)
scenario_results.SC9_what_about_it: PARTIAL — Falls to GENERAL_QUERY; usability gap, not security issue
scenario_results.SC10_security: PASS — No data leak, revert_slots() prevents unauthorized persistence

why_phase_13_2_2_tests_passed: TestGroup8 used a fresh session with no prior order turn. active_order_id=None, so update_slots_domain_aware only saw product_id in merged dict and operated correctly. The bug only manifests when active_order_id is non-null before the product turn.

recommended_fix.approach_a: Add explicit_entities field to IntentResult dataclass. Populate in classify(). Orchestrator uses route_decision.intent.explicit_entities for update_slots_domain_aware().
recommended_fix.approach_b: Orchestrator calls intent_classifier.extract_entities(query) directly for _explicit_entities. No dataclass change needed.
